system.description: When you cast this incantation, you cause a touched light source, such as a torch or lantern, to emanate truth in addition to light. Wherever its light is cast, creatures are unable to lie. This effect lasts for 10 minutes (1 dungeon action), and during that time, the light source rapidly consumes its fuel, invariably dying out at the end of the spell. Each spark increases the duration by 10 minutes (1 dungeon action). With three sparks, written lies glow like embers, revealing themselves as false.
